recipe.visualDefinition: A dark, moody composite image featuring multiple iterations of the same male subject interacting around a black leather sofa, accompanied by a female figure and bold, illustrative horror-style typography with a sci-fi icon.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject multiplicity creating a narrative loop
High-contrast lighting against a deep black void
Vibrant red and yellow graphic elements against muted earth tones
Centralized pyramid composition formed by the figures
coreInvariants: Deep black background with minimal floor texture
Black leather tufted sofa as the primary prop
Red plaid or patterned central clothing item
Jagged, hand-drawn aesthetic for display text

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central cluster of figures occupying the middle horizontal third; large display text anchored in the upper center.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central seated figure in red plaid shorts and the large red title text above.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the vibrant red title, moves down to the central seated figure, then radiates outward to the surrounding clones and the reclining female figure.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive black negative space at the top and bottom edges to emphasize the central action.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Black (background and sofa) providing a high-contrast foundation.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Tan and Red (clothing) to define the subjects against the dark environment.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Neon Green and Yellow (graphics) for visual pop and genre cues.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between the skin tones/clothing and the background; high saturation reserved for graphic overlays.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Extra-bold condensed sans-serif with irregular baselines
letterConstructionRules: Heavy black drop shadows for depth
Slanted or staggered alignment to create energy
Thick red fill with high-contrast outlines
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters have varying heights and widths to mimic hand-painted horror posters
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: A small, clean, high-contrast sans-serif for secondary 'meets' text to contrast the chaotic main title.
graphicDevices: Stylized UFO icon with yellow speed lines
Parental advisory and rating blocks in bottom corners

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the aggressive, hand-drawn energy of the original
Allows for the specific jagged, dripping aesthetic

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A dark studio shot of a black leather sofa. A man in red plaid shorts sits centrally, a woman in a black dress reclines next to him. Three clones of the man in tan jumpsuits lean over the back and sides of the sofa. Dramatic top-down lighting, deep shadows, black background.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large, two-tier title in the upper center using a jagged, red horror-style font with a thick black outline. Place a small yellow UFO icon with motion lines above the text. Add standard parental advisory and rating logos in the bottom corners.

verificationChecks: Text has a jagged, hand-drawn horror aesthetic
Multiple versions of the same male subject are present
Lighting is high-contrast with deep blacks
UFO icon is integrated into the title area

adjustableVariables: Clothing color of the central figure
Specific style of the UFO icon
Intensity of the red in the typography
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subjects
Specific wording of the title text
postGenerationChecks: Does the image maintain a dark, surreal atmosphere?
Is the typography the dominant graphic element?
Are the clones integrated naturally into the scene?
Is the color palette restricted to the specified tones?
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a multi-subject composite photography base with a 90s-horror-comic inspired typographic overlay and sci-fi iconography.
